name: approval_read_tool_exec_flag
notes: Read-only-tool program-execution flag finder. Harness traces a faithful copy of src/tools/approval_wrappers.c::appr_u_read_tool_exec_flag (the real shim prints to stdout, which would pollute the cup stream). Twin calls the LIVE tools/approval.py::_read_tool_exec_flag for the authoritative result and asserts its mirror ladder agrees on every input. Inputs restricted to the agreed contract; the shim does not model LIVE's long-options-with-arg skip or short-bundle ownership (documented gap), so inputs exercising those paths are excluded.
